capacity_notes: A68 annual values are not current turbine counts. Each year uses its own capacity, never latest capacity for historical output. Missing capacity gives null load factor. Sweden has no current-year country A68, so its last annual country A68 is held for current-year dates only (see capacity_latest.SE); this can slightly overstate the load factor if capacity grew. Bidding-zone A68 is a separate scope and is not summed to replace it.
